service_name.description: Name of the service or package being configured.

database_file.description: Path to the binary database file. Can end in .gz for automatic compression.

spam_threshold.description: Probability threshold above which a message is classified as spam.

good_threshold.description: Probability threshold below which a message is classified as good.

min_words.description: Minimum number of 'interesting' words required to produce a yes/no classification.
